test.title: How a tram line was saved

paragraphs.text: In 2010 the city council planned to close its last tram line because passenger numbers had fallen. A group of residents collected 20,000 signatures against the closure, and the council agreed to keep the line for a trial year. During that year, new timetables and cheaper tickets increased passenger numbers by forty per cent, and the line was kept.
paragraphs.label: A
